aboutText:
Elsa is a women's health practitioner and osteopath, trained in London, and genuinely fascinated by the intelligence of the female body.

But this work isn't just professional. It's personal.

For years, Elsa struggled with acne, PMS, gut issues and painful periods. Put on the pill at a young age, she spent seven years not knowing what her natural cycle even felt like. When she came off it, everything came back, but worse: the pain, the inflammation, the weight changes, the exhaustion. Despite being the most active she'd ever been. After a year of struggling and little real guidance, she accepted a coil out of sheer desperation.

It was during that time that everything shifted. She started working on her gut health, her nutrition, her inflammation. She started actually listening to her body. Four years later she removed the coil, and though it took time to readjust, for the first time things started to feel different. Less pain. Less PMS. More energy. Periods that made sense. A body she finally understood.

That experience is exactly why The Cycle Space exists. Because no woman should spend years feeling dismissed, confused or disconnected from her own body.

Elsa sees the whole person, not just the symptom. And she finds this work genuinely, endlessly fascinating, because every body has a story worth understanding.
disclaimer: Education and support — does not replace urgent medical care. If you are in distress or experiencing severe symptoms, please contact your doctor or local emergency services.

services.title: 1:1 Women's Health Consultation
services.body: A personalised session designed to help you understand what's happening in your body, why your symptoms are showing up, and co-create a plan to address them, without overwhelm. We look at the full picture: your cycle, your history, your lifestyle, your patterns. Then we build something practical, evidence-based and entirely yours.
